## Squad OKRs

Squad Objective: Operate a high-velocity, learning-driven squad.

Squad KRs:

1. ≥80% of experiments score ≥80% on the evaluator tool.
2. Run ≥16 experiments per quarter, with documented learnings.
3. Share at least one learning (win or fail) monthly in Friday Wins.
4. ≥90% of squad growth rituals (Quarterly Strategy, Monthly Focus, Weekly Syncs) are completed on time with all required artefacts prepared and shared in advance.

Squad Objective: Majority of users who fit the profile for Site Design, enter a site and complete [first strike for Site Design](https://share.autodesk.com/:fl:/r/contentstorage/CSP_0e46280c-ba21-46ae-9a7c-7491ade8421d/Document%20Library/LoopAppData/First%20Strike%20Moment%20-%20Site%20Design.loop?d=wdc259525883348db8e434f3290a628f5&csf=1&web=1&e=3Birct&%3D).

Squad KRs:

1. 70% of commercial new users enter a site in their first day (+35% from 35% baseline on Aug 31).
2. 60% of commercial new users in a site run an analysis on 3D geometry above terrain in first day (+30% from 30% baseline on Aug 31 which was without the 3D filter).
3. 50% of commercial new users in a site reach [first strike](https://share.autodesk.com/:fl:/r/contentstorage/CSP_0e46280c-ba21-46ae-9a7c-7491ade8421d/Document%20Library/LoopAppData/First%20Strike%20Moment%20-%20Site%20Design.loop?d=wdc259525883348db8e434f3290a628f5&csf=1&web=1&e=3Birct&%3D) for Site Design in their first day (+34% from 16% baseline on Aug 31 which was without the 3D filter).

Squad Objective: Majority of users who enter a board complete first strike for Board.

Squad KRs:

1. 35% of commercial new users enter a board in their first day (+29% from 6.2% baseline on Aug 31).
2. 40% of commercial new users in a board reach first strike for Board in their first day (+38% from 2% baseline on Aug 31).
3. Validate the value of first strike for Board: 50% of users who reach first strike for Board in their first day return to Forma within 30 days (+30% from 20% baseline, 🚧 to-be-confirmed).
